summary.tagline: Jagged limestone peaks meet the Pennard Pill river in a secluded Welsh bay.
summary.seo_title: Visiting Three Cliffs Bay | Gower Peninsula Guide

travel.headline: Open Access Coastal Exploration
travel.reservation: Entry to the bay and surrounding cliffs is generally open access with no central entry permit required. Visitors should check local land management or council updates for any temporary site restrictions or changes to nearby parking availability. Official sources do not list a specific booking system for the beach itself.

days.title: Rivers, Ruins, and Limestone Cliffs

stops.name: Three Cliffs Bay
stops.detail: View the jagged limestone cliffs and the Pennard Pill river as it cuts through the wooded hillside toward the sea. Observe the ruins of Pennard Castle overlooking the bay, though be aware that strong currents make the water unsuitable for swimming.

days.driving: Allow 30-45 minutes from Swansea; conditions vary by local traffic.
days.note: Reaching the bay requires a significant walk, which keeps the area quieter than other coastal spots; pacing is a suggestion for a leisurely visit.

intel.title: Walking Access
intel.text: Accessing the bay requires a walk through the valley or over the cliffs. Footpaths can be uneven and are subject to local weather conditions.

intel.title: Tidal Safety
intel.text: The Pennard Pill river and strong coastal currents are present in the bay. Visitors must check local tide tables to ensure safe passage across the sands and river mouth.

intel.title: Local Supplies
intel.text: Supplied evidence does not specify fuel or charging stations in the immediate vicinity. Verify locations in Swansea or nearby Gower villages before travel.

intel.title: Connectivity Gap
intel.text: Mobile signal strength is not confirmed in the evidence provided. Travelers should download maps for offline use before entering the wooded hillsides.

intel.title: Parking Locations
intel.text: Specific parking lot capacities are not listed in the official text. Check local signage at trailhead entry points for current parking permissions.

plan.arrival: Arrive in Swansea to pick up supplies before driving toward the Gower Peninsula. Locate designated parking areas near Pennard or Parkmill to begin the walk to the bay.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for the paved roads leading to the peninsula; check rental terms for narrow rural lane restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: The jagged cliffs provide a dramatic silhouette at sunset, though visibility depends on coastal mist and seasonal cloud cover.
